installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Shared installer helpers, embedded in egg JSON by sync.py.
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq unzip
USER_AGENT='STACloudMultiEgg/1.0 (stacloud.dev@gmail.com)'
fetch() { curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 180 -A "$USER_AGENT" "$@"; }
jar_name() {
    case "$1" in ''|-*|/*|*..*|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_./-]*) echo 'Invalid server JAR filename' >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
download_jar() (
    url=$1
    target=$2
    checksum=${3:-}
    jar_name "$target"
    case "$url" in https://*) ;; *) echo 'Download URL must use HTTPS' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")"
    tmp=$(mktemp "${target}.download.XXXXXX")
    trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT
    fetch -o "$tmp" "$url"
    [ -s "$tmp" ] && unzip -tq "$tmp" >/dev/null || { echo 'Downloaded file is not a valid JAR/ZIP; existing JAR preserved.' >&2; exit 1; }
    if [ -n "$checksum" ] && [ "$checksum" != null ]; then
        printf '%s  %s\n' "$checksum" "$tmp" | sha256sum -c - || exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
)
install_properties() {
    if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
        fetch -o server.properties.download https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ptero-eggs/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
        mv server.properties.download server.properties
    fi
}

jar=${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}
jar_name "$jar"
case "$jar" in *.jar) ;; *) jar="$jar.jar" ;; esac
mc=${MC_VERSION:-latest}
forge=${FORGE_VERSION:-}
build_type=${BUILD_TYPE:-recommended}
case "$build_type" in latest|recommended) ;; *) echo 'BUILD_TYPE must be latest or recommended' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
if [ -z "$forge" ]; then
    metadata=$(fetch https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/promotions_slim.json)
    if [ "$mc" = latest ] || [ -z "$mc" ]; then
        mc=$(jq -er '.promos | keys[] | select(endswith("-latest")) | sub("-latest$"; "")' <<< "$metadata" | sort -V | tail -n1)
    fi
    forge=$(jq -er --arg key "$mc-$build_type" --arg fallback "$mc-latest" '.promos[$key] // .promos[$fallback] // empty' <<< "$metadata")
else
    # A complete coordinate such as 1.20.1-47.3.0 is also accepted.
    if [[ "$forge" == *-* ]]; then mc=${forge%%-*}; forge=${forge#*-}; fi
    [ "$mc" != latest ] && [ -n "$mc" ] || { echo 'Set MC_VERSION when specifying a Forge build without its Minecraft prefix.' >&2; exit 1; }
fi
case "$mc-$forge" in *[!a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*) echo 'Invalid Forge coordinate' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
coordinate="$mc-$forge"
case "$mc" in 1.7.10|1.8.9) coordinate="$coordinate-$mc" ;; esac
download_jar "https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/$coordinate/forge-$coordinate-installer.jar" installer.jar
# Use an installer JVM matching the selected Minecraft generation.
java_major=25
case "$mc" in
    1.*)
        minor=$(cut -d. -f2 <<< "$mc")
        if [ "$minor" -lt 17 ]; then java_major=8
        elif [ "$minor" -eq 17 ]; then java_major=17
        elif [ "$minor" -lt 20 ]; then java_major=17
        elif [[ "$mc" == 1.20 || "$mc" == 1.20.[01234] ]]; then java_major=17
        else java_major=21; fi
        ;;
esac
case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) arch=aarch64 ;; *) echo 'Unsupported CPU architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
java_stage=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$java_stage"' EXIT
fetch -o "$java_stage/jdk.tar.gz" "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/binary/latest/$java_major/ga/linux/$arch/jdk/hotspot/normal/eclipse"
tar -xzf "$java_stage/jdk.tar.gz" -C "$java_stage" --strip-components=1
rm -f unix_args.txt
"$java_stage/bin/java" -jar installer.jar --installServer
# Select the exact generated args file rather than guessing Minecraft minor versions.
args_file="libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/$coordinate/unix_args.txt"
if [ -f "$args_file" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$args_file" unix_args.txt
else
    candidates=()
    for candidate in "forge-$coordinate.jar" "forge-$coordinate-universal.jar"; do
        [ -f "$candidate" ] || continue
        case "$candidate" in *-installer.jar) continue ;; esac
        candidates+=("$candidate")
    done
    [ ${#candidates[@]} -eq 1 ] || { echo 'Could not identify one generated Forge server JAR; inspect installer output.' >&2; exit 1; }
    mv "${candidates[0]}" "$jar"
fi
echo "Forge $mc-$forge installed. Select Java $java_major for the server runtime."
